cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities where file parsers fail to validate user-controlled integer values (offsets, sizes, counts) before using them in memory writes, loop bounds, or decompression. The lack of bounds checking allows attackers to trigger out-of-bounds writes, infinite loops, memory exhaustion, or CPU exhaustion via crafted files.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Replace inefficient algorithms with bulk operations (e.g., binascii.unhexlify) or linear-time counting sort for large runs..

sub_patterns.name: Inefficient algorithm causing CPU exhaustion
sub_patterns.root_cause: Algorithms for decoding or reordering untrusted input use O(n^2) or character-by-character processing, leading to excessive CPU time on large input.
